income_tax_extension.instructions: EXTENSION POINT for the Income-tax Act. Once its verified edition is in the release bundle, move reviewed questions into 'queries' with the catalogue statute_id and section_number exactly as the bundle records them (format, sub-section letters and hyphens included). Questions must not contain digits or a section reference. Until then the harness reports zero income-tax questions; nothing here is evaluated.
